name: pi-ask
description: Pi extension that adds an interactive ask_user clarification tool. Vendored from @eko24ive/pi-ask v1.2.0, see README.md for provenance.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'ROOT="$PWD"; TARGET="${1:-.}"; if [ "$TARGET" = "--" ]; then TARGET="${2:-.}"; fi; cd "$TARGET" && pi --no-extensions --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-themes --no-context-files -e "$ROOT/src/index.ts" --skill "$ROOT/skills/ask-user"' --
scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && npm test
